asi.cache_semantics: key = relative path; value = (size, mtime_ns, result). Any write updates mtime so a stat match proves same content for all flows we control (event appends, receipts); shutil.copy2 preserves size+mtime so the staged copy reuses the source scan's per-file results; events.ndjson appended between scans only re-reads that one file. Stats taken AFTER read so fingerprint matches bytes actually read. Unreadable files never cached. Sensitive scan also populates the hash cache so the publishable digest after a scan hits per-file hashes instead of re-reading.
